title: Search versus model error by exact enumeration at H <= 4

quantities.two_e_H_nats: 2 e_H of main Proposition 8: twice the stated-confidence quantile over planning instances of the maximum over the enumerated supported family of |J_hat(a) - J(a)|, with the critic sigma penalty identical in both objectives (nats)
quantities.zeta_H_nats: zeta_H of main Proposition 8: stated-confidence quantile over planning instances of J_hat(beam sequence) - min over the enumerated family of J_hat (nats)
quantities.realized_regret_nats: stated-confidence quantile over planning instances of J(beam sequence) - min over the enumerated family of J (nats)
quantities.bound_coverage: fraction of planning instances whose realized regret is at most 2 e_H + zeta_H at the pooled values (fraction)
quantities.beam_optimal_fraction: fraction of planning instances on which the registered beam returns a minimizer of J_hat over the enumerated family (fraction)
quantities.two_e_H_zero_uncertainty_nats: 2 e_H with the critic sigma term set to zero in the true objective J (nats)
quantities.mean_family_size: mean number of enumerated supported sequences per planning instance (sequences)
quantities.planning_instances: planning instances (input, member, depth) with a complete enumeration and a returned beam sequence (instances)

registered.label_role: D_select for independent-graph benchmarks, D_explore for single-graph benchmarks

notes: Produced by `python -B scripts/run_experiment_b.py search-enumeration plan --parent <run sealed through fit> --output <dir>`, `... search-enumeration run --plan <dir>/plan.json --device cuda --trust-local-checkpoints`, then `... search-enumeration export --results <dir> --hardware ... --period ...` (cm_experiments/search_enumeration.py). Planning states come from the released runtime: the initial measurement (MPC-OL) or the parent's registered MPC-RH policy executed by cross_morse.policies.execute_policy and replayed with its recorded actions and last-safe anchors. The family is every sequence the registered beam could expand without its top-k or beam-width truncation; J_hat uses beam_plan's exact arithmetic (Eq. 17, kappa = 1), J replaces the stage costs and the nominal-suffix terminal value by the frozen plant's measured loss changes on the declared label role. e_H is a supremum over the enumerated family per instance; the record states its stated-confidence quantile over instances (Note S20). The objective of single-graph benchmarks is evaluated on D_explore rows, the targets the consequence models were fitted to estimate.
